analysis.session_summary: The window was a broad USD rally: DXY gained +0.553 and USD was the strongest major at +0.516%, while GBP lagged at -0.308%. The inline FOMC hike still produced a 0.294% USD impulse, and the BoE's inline vote still sent GBP/USD down -96.3 pips. USD/JPY added +94.3 pips to 156.055 despite SPX +0.355 and VIX -2.297; Brent slid -1.226%. The tape shows USD strength driven by Fed messaging and US data, with commodity and European FX under pressure.

themes.evidence: USD strongest major at +0.516%; DXY +0.553; EUR/USD -58.5 pips; USD/JPY +94.3 pips.
GBP weakest major at -0.308%; GBP/USD -96.3 pips; EUR/GBP +18.2 pips.

themes.theme: Risk assets supported while oil retreats

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD fell -73.3 pips on the FOMC-driven USD bid into 04:45, then recovered only +18.3 pips into the close with no clear catalyst, leaving the pair at 1.14761.

polarity_reads.read: Inline FOMC produced a 0.294% USD impulse; the market was positioned for a dovish surprise, so the in-line 25bp hike was enough to squeeze USD shorts.

polarity_reads.event: MPC Official Bank Rate Votes +2 more
polarity_reads.read: BoE vote printed in line but GBP still weakened 0.289%; GBP longs likely needed a hawkish shift, so the repeat 3-0-6 split triggered selling.
Unscored press conference still added 0.096% USD; Warsh's inflation remarks were read as hawkish and reinforced the dollar bid.
A beat of 37.8 vs 31.3 gave USD a normal 0.122% impulse; the market is rewarding US data upside with USD strength.
NZD beat 0.2% vs 0.1% and initially gained 0.118%, but NZD/USD still closed -28.3 pips, showing the bid faded against broad USD strength.

scenarios.name: Post-FOMC USD consolidation
scenarios.thesis: USD gains are stretched after DXY +0.553 and several pairs are near session extremes, so profit-taking limits fresh extension before BOJ.
scenarios.invalidation: EUR/USD closes below 1.14761 and USD/JPY closes above 156.055.

pair_paths.rationale: Holding inside the 91.5 pip session range near 1.14761 as the USD bid stalls.
The 157.2 pip range allows pause near 156.055 before the BOJ decision.
After -96.3 pips, the 122.7 pip range provides room for consolidation.

scenarios.name: Dollar strength extends
scenarios.thesis: Hawkish Fed/Warsh messaging and strong US data keep the USD bid alive, extending the post-FOMC move.
scenarios.invalidation: USD/JPY falls back below 156.055 and EUR/USD reclaims 1.14761.

pair_paths.rationale: A break of 1.14761 targets the low end of the 91.5 pip daily range.
Extension from 156.055 can test the upper end of the 157.2 pip range.
GBP is the weakest major at -0.308%, so a retest of 1.33486 may open the 122.7 pip range.

scenarios.name: BOJ hawkish surprise / USD pullback
scenarios.thesis: A BOJ rate surprise or hawkish press conference triggers JPY strength and a broader USD long squeeze.
triggers: BOJ Policy Rate reads above the <1.25% forecast
scenarios.invalidation: BOJ holds <1.25% with a dovish tone and USD/JPY stays above 156.055.

pair_paths.rationale: BOJ hawkish surprise can drive the 157.2 pip range lower from 156.055.
If USD bids unwind, EUR/USD has 91.5 pips of range to recover toward the highs.
Oversold GBP after -96.3 pips can rebound within the 122.7 pip range.

risks.why_it_matters: USD/JPY closed +94.3 pips at 156.055; BOJ is the next high-impact catalyst for JPY crosses.
risks.watch: BOJ Policy Rate forecast <1.25% at 04:30 and BOJ Press Conference at 07:30.

risks.why_it_matters: GBP is the weakest major at -0.308% and GBP/USD is -96.3 pips, so a soft print can extend losses.
risks.watch: GBP Retail Sales m/m forecast -0.2% vs previous -0.5% at 08:00.

risks.why_it_matters: EUR/USD is -58.5 pips and EUR is -0.066%, so Lagarde can either reinforce or blunt the USD-driven pressure on EUR.
Brent/USD -1.226% and USD/NOK +714.1 show oil FX sensitivity to further crude decline.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: BOJ decision at 04:30 and press conference at 07:30 are the main swing factor for USD/JPY after its +94.3 pip day; GBP retail sales at 08:00 can move GBP/USD from 1.33486, and Lagarde at 12:30 can affect EUR/USD near 1.14761.
